paper_cards.title: SceneFun3D: Fine-Grained Functionality and Affordance Understanding in 3D Scenes
paper_cards.data: 710 high-resolution real-world indoor scenes with 14.8k functional interaction annotations, affordance labels, motion parameters, and task-language descriptions
paper_cards.method: large-scale 3D functionality annotation plus functionality segmentation, task-driven affordance grounding, and 3D motion estimation baselines
paper_cards.task: identify functional interactive elements, ground language tasks to affordance masks, and infer interaction motion parameters
paper_cards.novelty: moves 3D scene understanding from object-level semantics to actionable functional elements in real scanned indoor scenes
paper_cards.evidence: 710 scanned indoor scenes and 14.8k functional interaction annotations support functionality segmentation, affordance grounding, and motion-estimation baselines.
paper_cards.limitations: It is annotation and benchmark infrastructure rather than a generator; interaction motions are simplified primitives.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Defines reusable fields Object, Part, Affordance, FunctionalElement, TaskLanguage, MotionParameter for our typed interactive-world representation.

paper_cards.title: BEHAVIOR-1K: A Human-Centered, Embodied AI Benchmark with 1,000 Everyday Activities and Realistic Simulation
paper_cards.data: 1000 everyday activities, 50 scenes, more than 9000 objects, BDDL task predicates, and OmniGibson simulation support
paper_cards.method: human-centered task benchmark with formal predicate/task definitions and realistic simulator-backed execution
paper_cards.task: long-horizon household activity execution and evaluation in simulation
paper_cards.novelty: scales executable household tasks with semantic and physical properties, including rigid bodies, deformables, and liquids
paper_cards.evidence: The benchmark defines 1000 activities, 50 scenes, 9000+ objects, BDDL predicates, and OmniGibson execution support.
paper_cards.limitations: It is a benchmark and simulator stack; generated scenes still need robust asset/state annotation before direct use.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Directly informs Task, StatePredicate, GoalCondition, SceneObject, PhysicalProperty, and validation protocol design.

paper_cards.title: PhysX-Omni: Unified Simulation-Ready Physical 3D Generation for Rigid, Deformable, and Articulated Objects
paper_cards.data: PhysXVerse plus PhysX-Bench for geometry, scale, material, affordance, kinematics, and function description across rigid, deformable, and articulated objects
paper_cards.method: VLM-oriented physical 3D generation with an efficient geometry representation and benchmarked physical attribute understanding
paper_cards.task: generate simulation-ready physical 3D assets and evaluate physical/functional attributes
paper_cards.novelty: unifies rigid, deformable, and articulated physical 3D generation instead of treating them as separate asset categories
paper_cards.evidence: PhysX-Bench covers geometry, absolute scale, material, affordance, kinematics, and functional descriptions; the project page shows rigid, deformable, and articulated examples.
paper_cards.limitations: Very recent arXiv work; code and benchmark maturity need follow-up before using as a central baseline.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong candidate for PhysicalProperty, Material, DeformableState, KinematicJoint, and simulator export fields.

paper_cards.title: PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation
paper_cards.data: static 3D objects, video-diffusion dynamics priors, material-field estimates, and interaction examples for elastic objects
paper_cards.method: distills video generation priors into a physical material field and uses physics simulation to synthesize action-conditioned object dynamics
paper_cards.task: make static 3D objects respond to external forces or manipulation in physically plausible ways
paper_cards.novelty: uses video-generation dynamics priors to estimate material behavior for interactive 3D object simulation
paper_cards.evidence: Official examples show force-conditioned elastic dynamics synthesized from video-generation priors and material fields.
paper_cards.limitations: Examples are mostly object-level and elastic; contact-rich manipulation and full simulator integration need more checking.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Provides concrete fields for MaterialField, ExternalForce, DynamicResponse, and DeformableState validators.

paper_cards.title: Feature Splatting: Language-Driven Physics-Based Scene Synthesis and Editing
paper_cards.data: 3D Gaussian scenes with distilled foundation-model features, text-grounded decomposition, material queries, and physics-simulation examples
paper_cards.method: feature-bearing 3D Gaussians plus text-query segmentation and particle-based physics simulation with automatically assigned material properties
paper_cards.task: language-driven physics-based scene synthesis, editing, and material-aware simulation
paper_cards.novelty: turns 3DGS from a visual representation into a semantic/material/physics-aware editing and simulation substrate
paper_cards.evidence: Project figures demonstrate language-conditioned material/physics editing on 3D Gaussian-style scene representations.
paper_cards.limitations: Physics is demonstrated on selected cases; large cluttered interactive scenes and policy training remain unproven.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful for SceneRepresentation, MaterialProperty, SegmentByText, PhysicsEdit, and simulator-backed validation.

paper_cards.title: PhyScene: Physically Interactable 3D Scene Synthesis for Embodied AI
paper_cards.data: 3D scene layouts, 3D-FRONT / ProcTHOR conditions, articulated GAPartNet assets, and Isaac Sim interaction examples
paper_cards.method: conditional diffusion scene layout generation guided by collision, room-layout, and reachability/interactivity constraints
paper_cards.task: synthesize physically plausible and interactable 3D indoor scenes for embodied agents
paper_cards.novelty: adds physical and agent-interaction guidance to scene synthesis rather than optimizing only visual/layout naturalness
paper_cards.evidence: Reported experiments use physical and interactivity guidance for collision, reachability, articulation, and room-layout validity.
paper_cards.limitations: It depends on retrieved assets and engineered guidance; semantic task richness is narrower than full generative simulation.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Baseline for InteractionConstraint, Reachability, Collision, Articulation, and GeneratedScene validity metrics.

paper_cards.title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments
paper_cards.data: language prompts, Objaverse assets, AI2-THOR environments, human evaluations, and NoveltyTHOR navigation benchmark
paper_cards.method: LLM-driven environment generation with spatial relational constraints, asset retrieval, layout optimization, and AI2-THOR integration
paper_cards.task: generate customized 3D embodied AI environments from natural language
paper_cards.novelty: uses LLM commonsense plus constraint optimization to generate diverse interactive AI2-THOR environments from open-ended prompts
paper_cards.evidence: Official page and code show prompt-to-AI2-THOR environment generation and downstream embodied-agent evaluations.
paper_cards.limitations: Physical interaction is limited by AI2-THOR assets and runtime support.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Important baseline for Prompt, SceneSpec, SpatialConstraint, AssetRetrieval, LayoutOptimization, and downstream embodied evaluation.

paper_cards.title: Infinigen Indoors: Photorealistic Indoor Scenes using Procedural Generation
paper_cards.data: fully procedural indoor scenes, furniture, architecture elements, appliances, and dense synthetic labels from Blender
paper_cards.method: procedural indoor asset and layout generation with a constraint DSL and solver for scene composition
paper_cards.task: generate photorealistic indoor scenes and annotations for vision/embodied research
paper_cards.novelty: extends Infinigen from natural worlds to indoor procedural scenes with real geometry and controllable annotations
paper_cards.evidence: The system procedurally generates high-fidelity indoor scenes with controllable geometry and dense annotation potential.
paper_cards.limitations: Procedural visual realism still needs separate affordance and task-success validators.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong generator for Scene, Asset, Annotation, LayoutConstraint, and synthetic data pipelines.

paper_cards.title: RoboGen: Towards Unleashing Infinite Data for Automated Robot Learning via Generative Simulation
paper_cards.data: automatically generated tasks, scenes, training supervisions, demonstrations, and learned robotic skills in simulation
paper_cards.method: propose-generate-learn loop using foundation/generative models, task decomposition, scene generation, supervision generation, and policy learning
paper_cards.task: automated generation of robot learning tasks and policy training data
paper_cards.novelty: closes the loop from task proposal to simulated environment to training supervision and learned skill
paper_cards.evidence: The system proposes tasks, generates scenes/supervision, and trains policies in a propose-generate-learn loop.
paper_cards.limitations: Automated rewards and generated skills remain simulator-coverage dependent.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Directly motivates TaskGenerator, SceneGenerator, SupervisionGenerator, PolicyLearner, and validation-loop abstractions.

paper_cards.title: SpatialVLA: Exploring Spatial Representations for Visual-Language-Action Models
paper_cards.data: 1.1M real robot episodes and evaluations across 7 robot learning scenarios, 16 real-robot tasks, and 48 simulation setups
paper_cards.method: VLA with 3D Ego3D position encoding and adaptive spatial action grids for spatial action token prediction
paper_cards.task: spatially grounded generalist manipulation and spatial-prompt execution
paper_cards.novelty: injects explicit 3D spatial context and adaptive action grids into VLA policy learning
paper_cards.evidence: Reported experiments show spatial encodings and adaptive action grids improve language-conditioned manipulation.
paper_cards.limitations: It improves VLA policy execution but does not generate or validate full physical worlds.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful for Scene.spatial_graph, Ego3DEncoding, SpatialActionToken, and spatial instruction validation.

paper_cards.title: Octo: An Open-Source Generalist Robot Policy
paper_cards.data: 800k robot episodes from 25 Open X-Embodiment datasets across diverse robots, scenes, sensors, and labels
paper_cards.method: transformer-based diffusion policy supporting language and goal-image conditioning, flexible observations, and finetuning to new embodiments
paper_cards.task: generalist robot manipulation policy learning
paper_cards.novelty: open generalist policy recipe with flexible observation/action spaces and broad finetuning support
paper_cards.evidence: Open model, code, and multi-embodiment evaluations make it a practical generalist policy baseline.
paper_cards.limitations: It is policy infrastructure rather than a world model; language/spatial reasoning are weaker than newer VLA variants.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Baseline for Policy, Observation, ActionDistribution, GoalImageCondition, and embodiment adaptation.

paper_cards.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
paper_cards.data: 970k robot manipulation trajectories from Open X-Embodiment
paper_cards.method: 7B VLA built from a Prismatic VLM, SigLIP/DINOv2 fused visual encoder, Llama 2 backbone, and tokenized robot actions
paper_cards.task: open-source generalist robot manipulation and finetuning to new robot setups
paper_cards.novelty: first broadly usable open-source 7B VLA with released checkpoints, training pipeline, and PEFT/quantization support
paper_cards.evidence: Official release provides a 7B VLA, code, fine-tuning path, and real-robot evaluation evidence.
paper_cards.limitations: Action tokenization and semantic forgetting can limit hard OOD tasks.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Baseline for VLA policy execution, generated-task transfer, action-token interface, and finetuning experiments.

paper_cards.title: pi0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control
paper_cards.data: large robot interaction mixture spanning open-source data and proprietary dexterous data collected across 8 robot platforms
paper_cards.method: VLA flow model initialized from a 3B VLM and augmented with continuous high-frequency action outputs via flow matching
paper_cards.task: general robot control across dexterous, long-horizon, multi-stage real-world tasks
paper_cards.novelty: uses continuous flow-matching action generation to scale VLM-backed robot policies to dexterous control
paper_cards.evidence: Official demos show high-quality real-robot dexterity, deformable-object handling, and long-horizon household-style tasks.
paper_cards.limitations: Much training data and infrastructure are not public, so independent reproduction is limited.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Sets a high demo-quality target for robot execution, deformable manipulation, long-horizon interaction, and continuous action generation.

paper_cards.title: RoboVerse: Towards a Unified Platform, Dataset and Benchmark for Scalable and Generalizable Robot Learning
paper_cards.data: unified tasks, assets, scenes, trajectories, and standardized imitation/RL benchmarks for robot learning
paper_cards.method: platform-level dataset and benchmark infrastructure with standardized training/evaluation protocols and baselines
paper_cards.task: scalable and generalizable robot learning evaluation across tasks and embodiments
paper_cards.novelty: unifies platform, dataset, task assets, and benchmark protocols for scalable robot learning
paper_cards.evidence: The project organizes robot-learning tasks, datasets, trajectories, and benchmark-style evaluation infrastructure.
paper_cards.limitations: Benchmark maturity and exact dataset coverage need local testing before central experimental adoption.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful for benchmark packaging, generated-task evaluation, policy baselines, and trajectory/data schema design.

paper_cards.title: OpenEQA: Embodied Question Answering in the Era of Foundation Models
paper_cards.data: embodied question-answering benchmark over physical/scanned environments
paper_cards.method: open-vocabulary embodied QA benchmark and LLM-Match answer evaluation protocol
paper_cards.task: answer natural-language questions about an embodied environment
paper_cards.novelty: modern open-vocabulary embodied QA benchmark for evaluating environment understanding
paper_cards.evidence: OpenEQA defines open-vocabulary embodied QA evaluation over egocentric observations and environment memory.
paper_cards.limitations: It evaluates semantics and embodied QA, not visual generation or robot policy success.
paper_cards.project_relevance: downstream benchmark for testing whether generated interactive environments preserve object identity, spatial relations, and semantic affordances

paper_cards.title: PhysX-Anything: Simulation-Ready Physical 3D Assets from Single Image
paper_cards.data: PhysX-Mobility with 2K+ common objects plus in-the-wild single-image inputs and physical/articulation annotations
paper_cards.method: VLM-based physical 3D generative model with efficient geometry tokenization and explicit geometry, articulation, and physical attributes
paper_cards.task: generate simulation-ready physical 3D assets from a single image
paper_cards.novelty: turns image-conditioned 3D generation into sim-ready assets with physical and articulation metadata
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports sim-ready physical assets from single images, explicit geometry/articulation/physical properties, PhysX-Mobility with 2K+ annotated objects, and simulation-based policy learning evidence.
paper_cards.limitations: Object-level asset generation; full scene/task integration still requires composition and validation.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong object-level source for PhysicalProperty, KinematicJoint, AssetToSimulator, and contact-rich policy-learning validation.

paper_cards.title: SimuScene: Simulation-Ready Compositional 3D Scene Reconstruction from a Single Image
paper_cards.data: single-image compositional 3D scene reconstruction benchmarks plus humanoid and robot-arm downstream deployments
paper_cards.method: physics-in-the-loop compositional reconstruction that converts simulation failures into shape/layout correction signals
paper_cards.task: reconstruct stable simulation-ready 3D scenes from one image
paper_cards.novelty: uses physics simulation as a diagnostic measurement tool during generation rather than only post-hoc cleanup
paper_cards.evidence: The paper puts physics in the loop of shape and layout estimation, using gravity simulation signals to correct penetration/support failures and showing humanoid and robot-arm deployment examples.
paper_cards.limitations: Published only days before this run; project/code maturity and visual demos need rechecking.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Relevant to SceneTree, SupportRelation, PhysicalViolation, and simulator-ready reconstruction validators.

paper_cards.title: REST3D: Reconstructing Physically Stable 3D Scenes from a Single Image
paper_cards.data: synthetic and real-world single-RGB-image reconstruction datasets, Isaac Gym simulation checks, and VR interaction demos
paper_cards.method: agentic physical scene understanding, scene-tree construction, image-to-3D initialization, and physics-constrained refinement
paper_cards.task: reconstruct physically stable interactive 3D scenes from a single RGB image
paper_cards.novelty: uses gravity-support scene trees as structural priors for stable scene reconstruction
paper_cards.evidence: Project and arXiv describe scene-tree physical understanding, image-to-3D initialization, physics-constrained optimization, Isaac Gym simulation, and VR human-object interaction demos.
paper_cards.limitations: Code is marked as coming soon on the project page; local reproduction is pending.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Provides a useful template for SceneTree, SupportGraph, StabilityCheck, and PhysicsRefinement stages.

paper_cards.title: TriSplat: Simulation-Ready Feed-Forward 3D Scene Reconstruction
paper_cards.data: RealEstate10K, DL3DV, ScanNet-style sparse-view reconstruction evaluations
paper_cards.method: feed-forward oriented-triangle splatting network that predicts point maps, triangle attributes, camera poses, and mesh-ready surfaces
paper_cards.task: reconstruct simulation-ready mesh scenes from sparse or pose-free images
paper_cards.novelty: replaces Gaussian primitives with oriented triangle primitives that can be ingested by physics/rendering pipelines without post-hoc meshing
paper_cards.evidence: The paper uses oriented triangle primitives to directly export simulation-ready mesh scenes from sparse images without Gaussian-to-mesh post-processing.
paper_cards.limitations: Scene interaction semantics and physical material properties are outside the main contribution.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful representation reference for MeshScene, CollisionSurface, and feed-forward sim-ready reconstruction.

paper_cards.title: Steerable Scene Generation
paper_cards.data: over 44M procedurally generated SE(3) scene placements
paper_cards.method: diffusion scene prior steered by RL, conditioning and MCTS
paper_cards.task: generate scenes satisfying task and physical objectives
paper_cards.novelty: combines PCG-scale data with inference-time search and downstream steering
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports a scene prior trained from more than 44M procedurally generated SE(3) placements, then steered by RL and search objectives.
paper_cards.limitations: Project/demo evidence is weaker than SAGE or SceneSmith; treat it as a method baseline rather than a visual-quality anchor.
paper_cards.project_relevance: strong baseline for task-constrained scene generation

paper_cards.title: SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI
paper_cards.data: SAGE-10k task-conditioned synthetic scenes and generated objects
paper_cards.method: agentic PCG with semantic, visual and physical critics
paper_cards.task: task-conditioned indoor scene generation for embodied AI
paper_cards.novelty: uses critics and iterative tool selection to improve simulator-ready scenes
paper_cards.evidence: Official CVPR 2026 page describes SAGE-10k, task-conditioned scene generation, semantic/visual/physical critics, and scaling trends for policies trained on generated data.
paper_cards.limitations: Very recent release; exact dataset/license details and independent reproduction still need checking.
paper_cards.project_relevance: closest PCG baseline; it can use a typed interaction representation as I/O and evaluator

paper_cards.title: EmbodiedGen: Towards a Generative 3D World Engine for Embodied Intelligence
paper_cards.data: 3D assets, articulated objects, scene and layout generation modules
paper_cards.method: generative 3D world engine for embodied intelligence
paper_cards.task: generate interactive 3D worlds and assets
paper_cards.novelty: packages multiple generative modules for embodied world construction
paper_cards.evidence: The arXiv abstract and project page describe image-to-3D, text-to-3D, texture, articulated-object, scene, and layout generation modules with URDF/simulation support.
paper_cards.limitations: The engine-style paper covers many modules; per-module quality should be checked before using as a baseline.
paper_cards.project_relevance: generation engine that can consume or be evaluated by a typed interactive-world representation

paper_cards.title: SceneSmith: Agentic Generation of Simulation-Ready Indoor Scenes
paper_cards.data: text-prompted indoor scenes, generated static assets, retrieved articulated objects, physical properties, and example scene dataset
paper_cards.method: hierarchical agentic text-to-scene framework with designer, critic, and orchestrator VLM agents across layout, furniture, and object-population stages
paper_cards.task: generate dense simulation-ready indoor environments from natural language prompts
paper_cards.novelty: combines agentic generation with physical property estimation and policy-evaluation-ready scene export
paper_cards.evidence: Official ICML 2026 Spotlight page reports hierarchical VLM agents, dense object population, articulated-object retrieval, physical property estimation, under 2 percent inter-object collisions, and policy-evaluation use.
paper_cards.limitations: Pipeline complexity and dependency on multiple generators/assets may make reproduction heavy.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Top PCG baseline for PromptToScene, CriticLoop, ObjectPopulation, PhysicalProperty, and policy evaluation.

paper_cards.title: SceneFoundry: Generating Interactive Infinite 3D Worlds
paper_cards.data: apartment-scale generated 3D worlds with articulated assets from large-scale repositories
paper_cards.method: language-guided diffusion with LLM floor-plan control, posterior sampling for object population, articulation-collision and walkability guidance
paper_cards.task: generate large-scale interactive and physically usable indoor 3D worlds
paper_cards.novelty: focuses on functionally articulated furniture and apartment-scale interactive world generation
paper_cards.evidence: The arXiv paper reports language-guided diffusion for apartment-scale worlds with articulated furniture, articulation-collision guidance, and walkable-space constraints.
paper_cards.limitations: Project page appears lighter than SceneSmith/SAGE; visual quality and asset release should be rechecked.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Relevant PCG line for LayoutConstraint, ArticulationConstraint, WalkableSpace, and infinite-world expansion.

paper_cards.title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
paper_cards.data: text, single-view, multi-view, and video inputs; generated 3DGS/mesh worlds; released model weights and code
paper_cards.method: four-stage world pipeline with panorama generation, trajectory planning, world expansion, reconstruction, and WorldLens rendering
paper_cards.task: reconstruct, generate, and simulate navigable 3D worlds from multimodal inputs
paper_cards.novelty: unifies generation and reconstruction for explorable 3D worlds with open weights/code
paper_cards.evidence: The technical report and official model card describe text/image/multi-view/video inputs, 3DGS/mesh outputs, WorldNav/WorldStereo/WorldMirror components, WorldLens rendering, and released weights/code.
paper_cards.limitations: General world generation is not robotics-specific; physical interaction fidelity must be tested before embodied-policy use.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong open-source world-generation baseline for WorldRepresentation, TrajectoryPlan, 3DGSScene, MeshExport, and engine integration.

paper_cards.title: SpatialBot: Precise Spatial Understanding with Vision Language Models
paper_cards.data: SpatialQA and RGB-D spatial-understanding benchmark data
paper_cards.method: RGB-D vision-language model for precise spatial understanding
paper_cards.task: spatial VQA and embodied AI tasks
paper_cards.novelty: feeds both RGB and depth to improve metric spatial reasoning
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports SpatialQA/SpatialBench and an RGB-D VLM setup for depth-related spatial reasoning and embodied tasks.
paper_cards.limitations: It is a spatial VLM rather than a generator or robot policy; use it as a validator or representation baseline.
paper_cards.project_relevance: supports grounding spatial relations from observations

paper_cards.title: HiSpatial: Taming Hierarchical 3D Spatial Understanding in Vision-Language Models
paper_cards.data: about 5M images and over 45M objects converted into 3D spatial VQA pairs
paper_cards.method: hierarchical 3D spatial understanding pipeline and VLM fine-tuning
paper_cards.task: 3D spatial relation and reasoning benchmarks
paper_cards.novelty: large-scale hierarchical spatial supervision for VLMs
paper_cards.evidence: Official CVPR 2026 page reports hierarchical 3D spatial supervision, roughly 5M images, and over 45M object-level spatial annotations.
paper_cards.limitations: It targets VLM spatial reasoning, not executable simulation; generated-world use needs conversion to validators.
paper_cards.project_relevance: useful for spatial relation completion and validation

paper_cards.title: SpaceTools: Tool-Augmented Spatial Reasoning via Double Interactive RL
paper_cards.data: Toolshed infrastructure and spatial reasoning benchmarks such as RoboSpatial-Home, BLINK and BOP-ask
paper_cards.method: tool-augmented spatial reasoning with Double Interactive Reinforcement Learning
paper_cards.task: metric spatial reasoning and robot tool use
paper_cards.novelty: lets VLMs call vision and robotic tools for precise spatial answers
paper_cards.evidence: Official CVPR 2026 page reports tool-augmented spatial reasoning over RoboSpatial-Home, BLINK, BOP-ask, and a 7-DOF robot as a spatial tool.
paper_cards.limitations: Tool availability and exact integration cost need local testing.
paper_cards.project_relevance: prototype for target-task validators that invoke measurement/simulation tools

paper_cards.title: Spatial Reasoning with Vision-Language Models in Ego-Centric Multi-View Scenes
paper_cards.data: over 8600 egocentric multi-view outdoor spatial QA pairs
paper_cards.method: cognitive-map based post-training using estimated global 3D coordinates
paper_cards.task: multi-view egocentric spatial reasoning
paper_cards.novelty: evaluates embodied multi-view spatial reasoning beyond single images
paper_cards.evidence: The paper introduces Ego3D-Bench with 8600+ human-verified egocentric multi-view QA pairs and Ego3D-VLM with cognitive-map post-training.
paper_cards.limitations: Outdoor egocentric scenes are useful for spatial reasoning but less directly aligned with household manipulation scenes.
paper_cards.project_relevance: supports Scene coordinate-frame and relation grounding

paper_cards.title: Seeing Across Views / MV-RoboBench
paper_cards.data: multi-view robotic manipulation scenes with spatial QA
paper_cards.method: benchmarking multi-view spatial reasoning of VLMs in robotic scenes
paper_cards.task: spatial and robotic reasoning across synchronized camera views
paper_cards.novelty: shows single-view spatial reasoning does not transfer reliably to robotic multi-view settings
paper_cards.evidence: The ICLR 2026 paper benchmarks multi-view spatial reasoning in robotic manipulation scenes and shows single-view reasoning does not reliably transfer.
paper_cards.limitations: Benchmark details should be checked from the OpenReview paper before using exact metric values.
paper_cards.project_relevance: important benchmark for observation-to-scene-graph parsing

paper_cards.title: DepthVLA: Enhancing Vision-Language-Action Models with Depth-Aware Spatial Reasoning
paper_cards.data: real-world, LIBERO and Simpler evaluations
paper_cards.method: mixture-of-transformers combining VLM, depth transformer and action expert
paper_cards.task: depth-aware language-conditioned manipulation
paper_cards.novelty: adds explicit depth reasoning to VLA with strong real and sim gains
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports depth-aware mixture-of-transformers integration and gains on real-world tasks, LIBERO, and Simpler.
paper_cards.limitations: Code availability is stated as planned; exact reproducibility is pending.
paper_cards.project_relevance: supports depth-based scene grounding and precise spatial action

paper_cards.title: ST-VLA: Enabling 4D-Aware Spatiotemporal Understanding for General Robot Manipulation
paper_cards.data: ST-Human with 14 tasks and 300k episodes plus RLBench and real-world tasks
paper_cards.method: 3D-4D representation, spatial masks and spatiotemporal VLM
paper_cards.task: open-world long-horizon robot manipulation
paper_cards.novelty: bridges semantic reasoning and continuous control through 4D spatial context
paper_cards.evidence: The paper introduces ST-Human with 14 tasks and 300k episodes plus 3D-4D spatial masks for long-horizon manipulation.
paper_cards.limitations: Dataset release and cross-embodiment reproduction need follow-up.
paper_cards.project_relevance: points to temporal/deformable state and trajectory grounding

paper_cards.title: SpatialStack: Layered Geometry-Language Fusion for 3D VLM Spatial Reasoning
paper_cards.data: multiple 3D spatial reasoning benchmarks and VLM-SpatialStack training/evaluation data
paper_cards.method: layered geometry-language fusion that injects multi-level geometric features into a VLM hierarchy
paper_cards.task: 3D spatial reasoning for embodied and physical AI systems
paper_cards.novelty: moves beyond late-stage geometry fusion by stacking hierarchical geometric signals through the language backbone
paper_cards.evidence: Official CVPR 2026 page and arXiv report hierarchical vision-geometry-language fusion and broad 3D spatial reasoning gains.
paper_cards.limitations: It is a spatial reasoning model rather than a task generator; role is validator/encoder.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Good spatial encoder/validator reference for local geometry, global context, and relation checking in generated worlds.

paper_cards.title: VLA-R1: Enhancing Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models
paper_cards.data: reasoning-augmented VLA training examples
paper_cards.method: explicit reasoning enhancement for VLA
paper_cards.task: vision-language-action reasoning and manipulation
paper_cards.novelty: adds reasoning traces/planning to VLA action generation
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports RLVR/GRPO post-training, VLA-CoT-13K, and in-domain/OOD/sim/real-robot evaluations.
paper_cards.limitations: Model/code/dataset release timing should be rechecked before depending on it.
paper_cards.project_relevance: bridges target-task predicates and action selection

paper_cards.title: World Action Models: The Next Frontier in Embodied AI
paper_cards.data: survey/position paper over VLA and world-model research
paper_cards.method: formal definition of action-conditioned world modeling
paper_cards.task: model physical evolution under interventions
paper_cards.novelty: separates reactive VLA from intervention-aware world-action modeling
paper_cards.evidence: The paper formalizes action-conditioned world modeling and surveys data/evaluation ecosystems for visual fidelity, physical commonsense, and action plausibility.
paper_cards.limitations: It is a survey/position paper rather than a runnable model.
paper_cards.project_relevance: aligns directly with target-task StateTransition and ValidationReport

paper_cards.title: Physically Viable World Models
paper_cards.data: conceptual/query-conditioned embodied AI framework
paper_cards.method: physically viable transition model for intervention queries
paper_cards.task: answer action-outcome queries under physical structure
paper_cards.novelty: requires world models to preserve intervention-relevant physical structure
paper_cards.evidence: The paper frames world models around intervention queries and physical viability rather than passive video prediction.
paper_cards.limitations: Conceptual framework; implementation and benchmark artifacts need follow-up.
paper_cards.project_relevance: supports the target representation as a query-conditioned physical interface

paper_cards.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
paper_cards.data: large mixed humanoid/robot datasets plus simulation benchmark evaluations and released model artifacts
paper_cards.method: open foundation model for humanoid robots with reasoning and action components trained on diverse robot data
paper_cards.task: generalist humanoid robot control under language and visual instructions
paper_cards.novelty: one of the first open humanoid foundation models with official weights and reproducible release path
paper_cards.evidence: Official NVIDIA page and arXiv describe an open humanoid foundation model with simulation benchmarks and multi-embodiment training evidence.
paper_cards.limitations: Humanoid focus may not transfer directly to tabletop generation tasks; later GR00T releases should be tracked separately.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Important VLA baseline for humanoid embodiments and synthetic-data-to-policy evaluation.

paper_cards.title: Green-VLA: Staged Vision-Language-Action Model for Generalist Robots
paper_cards.data: 3000 hours of demonstrations, Simpler BRIDGE WidowX, CALVIN ABC-D, and real-robot evaluations
paper_cards.method: five-stage VLA curriculum with multimodal grounding, multi-embodiment pretraining, embodiment adaptation, and RL policy alignment
paper_cards.task: generalist robot control across humanoids, mobile manipulators, and fixed-base arms
paper_cards.novelty: combines staged training, embodiment-aware actions, OOD detection, and RL alignment for real deployment
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports a staged curriculum, 3000 hours of demonstrations, multi-embodiment action interface, and real/sim evaluations.
paper_cards.limitations: Hardware-specific parts and data availability need checking.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful systems reference for staged VLA training and safety-aware execution.

paper_cards.title: XR-1: Towards Versatile Vision-Language-Action Models via Learning Unified Vision-Motion Representations
paper_cards.data: large-scale cross-embodiment robot datasets plus more than 14,000 rollouts on six robot embodiments and 120+ tasks
paper_cards.method: Unified Vision-Motion Codes learned by dual-branch VQ-VAE with three-stage VLA training
paper_cards.task: versatile robot manipulation across diverse embodiments and environments
paper_cards.novelty: aligns visual dynamics and robot motion into a shared intermediate code for scalable VLA learning
paper_cards.evidence: Project and arXiv report UVMC, three-stage training, six robot embodiments, more than 120 tasks, and over 14k real-world rollouts.
paper_cards.limitations: Large-scale rollout claims are official; independent reproduction and checkpoint availability should be checked.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Strong VLA reference for cross-embodiment action representation and real rollout quality.

paper_cards.title: TwinVLA: Data-Efficient Bimanual Manipulation with Twin Single-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
paper_cards.data: single-arm public robot data plus bimanual real-world and simulation task evaluations
paper_cards.method: modular composition of two pretrained single-arm VLA policies into a coordinated bimanual policy
paper_cards.task: data-efficient bimanual manipulation from vision-language instructions
paper_cards.novelty: reuses single-arm data and policies instead of requiring full bimanual pretraining
paper_cards.evidence: Official ICLR 2026 page reports composing two single-arm VLAs for bimanual tasks without bimanual pretraining.
paper_cards.limitations: It is bimanual-policy focused; use as baseline for dexterous/bimanual tasks rather than general world generation.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Good baseline for bimanual task generation and policy-evaluation suites.

paper_cards.title: MMaDA-VLA: Large Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model with Unified Multi-Modal Instruction and Generation
paper_cards.data: simulation benchmarks and real-world robot tasks including LIBERO and CALVIN-style evaluations
paper_cards.method: native discrete diffusion VLA that jointly denoises language, images, future observations, and action chunks
paper_cards.task: language-conditioned robot manipulation with parallel action and future-observation generation
paper_cards.novelty: unifies multimodal instruction understanding, future visual generation, and action prediction in one diffusion backbone
paper_cards.evidence: The paper reports a native discrete diffusion VLA that jointly denoises language, images, future goal observations, and action chunks, with LIBERO/CALVIN results.
paper_cards.limitations: Very new; code/checkpoint maturity should be rechecked.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Relevant to world-action interfaces because it predicts future visual outcomes and actions jointly.

paper_cards.title: EWMBench: Evaluating Embodied World Models
paper_cards.data: embodied world model evaluation scenarios
paper_cards.method: multi-dimensional embodied world-model benchmark
paper_cards.task: evaluate scene, motion, semantic and interaction consistency
paper_cards.novelty: moves world-model evaluation beyond pixel/video quality
paper_cards.evidence: The benchmark targets scene, motion, semantic, and interaction consistency for embodied world models.
paper_cards.limitations: Exact scenarios, metrics, and release artifacts need rechecking before central use.
paper_cards.project_relevance: evaluation philosophy for interactive embodied generation benchmark

paper_cards.title: WorldScore: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for World Generation
paper_cards.data: world generation outputs and scoring dimensions
paper_cards.method: unified benchmark for world generation
paper_cards.task: score quality, consistency, controllability and interactivity
paper_cards.novelty: multi-dimensional evaluation for generated worlds
paper_cards.evidence: The benchmark includes 3000 test examples and evaluates controllability, quality, and dynamics across 19 representative world-generation models.
paper_cards.limitations: It evaluates next-scene/world generation, not all embodied interaction properties; map metrics carefully to our benchmark.
paper_cards.project_relevance: baseline for interactive embodied generation benchmark metrics

paper_cards.title: WorldArena: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating Perception and Functional Utility of Embodied World Models
paper_cards.data: public benchmark, leaderboard, dataset, and challenge for embodied world models
paper_cards.method: perception and functional-utility benchmark with 16 numerical video metrics, task-functionality evaluation, human judgment, and EWMScore
paper_cards.task: evaluate embodied world models as perceptual predictors, synthetic data engines, policy evaluators, and action planners
paper_cards.novelty: ties world-model evaluation to functional embodied utility rather than video quality alone
paper_cards.evidence: Official benchmark and arXiv describe perception metrics, embodied task functionality, EWMScore, public leaderboard, dataset, and challenge links.
paper_cards.limitations: Leaderboard and challenge are active; exact baselines and datasets may evolve quickly.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Important evaluation target for our interactive embodied world generator and world-model branches.

paper_cards.title: World-in-World: World Models in a Closed-Loop World
paper_cards.data: closed-loop world-model benchmark tasks, unified action API, code, leaderboard, and demos
paper_cards.method: closed-loop evaluation platform where planners propose actions and world models predict future observations inside task loops
paper_cards.task: evaluate visual world models by embodied utility in closed-loop interaction
paper_cards.novelty: evaluates world models under recursive agent-world interaction rather than one-step visual prediction
paper_cards.evidence: Official ICLR 2026 Oral page and code describe closed-loop world-model evaluation with unified action APIs and benchmark tasks.
paper_cards.limitations: Closed-loop utility is benchmark-specific; model coverage and task set should be checked before citing exact rankings.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Provides a harness template for action-conditioned rollout evaluation and closed-loop generated-world testing.

paper_cards.title: Ctrl-World
paper_cards.data: policy-in-the-loop rollouts and real-world/world-model comparisons for generalist robot policies
paper_cards.method: controllable world-model evaluation designed to let generalist robot policies roll out actions inside imagination space
paper_cards.task: evaluate whether world models support policy-in-the-loop manipulation rollouts
paper_cards.novelty: centers evaluation on policy utility and rollout control rather than passive generation quality
paper_cards.evidence: Official ICLR 2026 page describes policy-in-the-loop rollouts with generalist robot policies and comparisons between real-world and imagined rollouts.
paper_cards.limitations: Needs deeper source checking for dataset/model release and exact benchmark protocol.
paper_cards.project_relevance: Useful benchmark design for world-action model validators and imagined rollout tests.
